tools.name: highlyt_list_documents
tools.description:
List PDF documents in your Highlyt library.

Returns documents sorted by last update time with pagination.
Filter by shelf_id to see documents in a specific collection.

tools.name: highlyt_get_document
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a document.

Returns full metadata including book context, reading progress,
and organizational information.

tools.name: highlyt_get_research_brief
tools.description:
Read a researcher-authored brief with verified, reviewed source receipts.

Use this as context only. Cite only the included receipts. The tool does
not reveal a draft reference or proposed evidence as support for a claim.

tools.name: highlyt_export_research_brief_markdown
tools.description: Export a portable researcher-authored Markdown brief with safe receipts.

tools.name: highlyt_list_highlights
tools.description:
List highlights in a document with pagination.

Returns up to 'limit' highlights (default 20, max 50) starting from 'offset'.
Use has_more and next_offset to paginate through all highlights.
Each highlight includes the color meaning (e.g., "Key concepts", "Questions").

tools.name: highlyt_create_highlight
tools.description:
Create a new highlight in a document.

Uses react-pdf-highlighter-extended format:
- position: ScaledPosition with boundingRect, rects, pageNumber
- content: {text: "..."} or {image: "..."}
- highlight_type: "text" or "area"
- comment: User's comment
Colors should be hex codes (e.g., #FFEB3B for yel

tools.name: highlyt_update_highlight
tools.description:
Update a highlight's color or comment.

Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: highlyt_delete_highlight
tools.description:
Delete a highlight permanently.

This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: highlyt_list_highlight_links
tools.description:
List highlight links (insight threads) in a document with pagination.

Returns up to 'limit' links (default 50, max 100) starting from 'offset'.
Use has_more and next_offset to paginate through all links.
Each link has a type: 'related', 'supports', 'contradicts', 'expands', or 'questions'.

tools.name: highlyt_get_highlight_links
tools.description:
Get all links connected to a specific highlight.

Returns parent links (where this highlight is referenced by others)
and child links (where this highlight references others).
Useful for exploring how a specific idea connects to other highlights.

tools.name: highlyt_create_highlight_link
tools.description:
Create a link between two highlights to form an insight thread.
Supports both same-document and cross-document linking.

IMPORTANT — parent/child semantics:
- parent_highlight_id = the highlight you are viewing (the "context" highlight)
- child_highlight_id = the highlight you are linking TO (the "r

tools.name: highlyt_update_highlight_link
tools.description:
Update a highlight link's relationship type or note.

Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: highlyt_delete_highlight_link
tools.description:
Delete a link between two highlights.

This removes the connection but does not delete the highlights themselves.

tools.name: highlyt_get_cross_document_links
tools.description:
List all cross-document highlight links for the current user.

Returns links where source_document_id != target_document_id,
with metadata about both source and target documents.
Useful for exploring connections across your entire library.

tools.name: highlyt_list_cluster_summaries
tools.description:
List all cluster summaries for a document's knowledge graph.

Returns each summary with its highlight_ids array — the highlights that were
in the cluster when the summary was last generated.

tools.name: highlyt_delete_cluster_summary
tools.description:
Delete a cluster summary from the knowledge graph.

This removes the summary record but does not affect the highlights or their links.

tools.name: highlyt_get_page_text
tools.description:
Retrieve the text content of specific pages from a document.

Use this to read document content before creating highlights.
Returns up to 5 pages per request. If the requested range exceeds 5 pages,
use has_more and next_page_start to paginate through remaining pages.

tools.name: highlyt_get_document_images
tools.description:
Retrieve images (charts, graphs, figures, diagrams, photos) and their surrounding
text context from an EPUB or web clip document.

WHEN TO USE THIS TOOL:
- User asks about a chart, graph, figure, diagram, or image in a document
- User wants visual data or illustrations from a book/article
- User ref

tools.name: highlyt_create_text_highlight
tools.description:
Create a text-based highlight on a specific page.

Use this after reading page content with highlyt_get_page_text.
The highlight will appear in the sidebar and be searchable/exportable.
Copy the exact text from the page content for the 'text' field.

tools.name: highlyt_bulk_create_highlights
tools.description:
Create multiple text-based highlights in one batch (max 10 per request).

Efficient for chapter analysis — create highlights in batches of up to 10.
If you have more than 10, split into multiple calls.

Highlight format: {page_number: int, text: str, comment?: str, color?: str}
Colors: amber (#E5A84

tools.name: highlyt_export_highlights
tools.description:
Export document highlights for AI context with pagination.

Returns up to 'limit' highlights (default 20, max 50) starting from 'offset'.
Use has_more and next_offset to paginate through all highlights.
Includes document metadata, color meanings, and insight threads
relevant to the returned highligh

tools.name: highlyt_search_highlights
tools.description:
Search highlights across your library.

Finds highlights containing the query text.
Each result includes the color meaning based on the document's definitions.
Optionally limit to a specific document.

tools.name: highlyt_search
tools.description:
Full-text search across your entire library — documents, highlights, and page content.

This searches the actual text content of your PDFs (every page), highlight text/comments,
and document metadata (title, author, keywords). Results are ranked by relevance with
text snippets showing where matches

tools.name: highlyt_list_research_projects
tools.description: List the caller's research projects for a bounded AI research task.

tools.name: highlyt_list_references
tools.description:
List reviewed references, optionally in one project.

Drafts are excluded unless include_drafts is explicitly true. Never cite a
draft as a verified source.

tools.name: highlyt_get_reference
tools.description: Get one reviewed research reference. Never cite a draft without explicit permission.

tools.name: highlyt_export_references
tools.description:
Export reviewed references as BibTeX, RIS, or canonical CSL-JSON.

This always excludes drafts. Never cite a draft as a verified source.
